what_to_detect: A spell cast from exile out of a card that was exiled face down is on the stack face up (its face state is front, its cast-from zone exile) at the next priority stop, because the card turned face up just before it was cast.
near_miss: A face-down exiled card cast face down (morph, disguise) is on the stack with face state face_down.
record_fields: the exiled card's face_state face_down in an earlier record's snapshot

what_to_detect: A decision candidate casting a face-down card from exile under a permission naming a spell quality is playable (can_play true) when the resulting spell has that quality.
near_miss: A candidate casting a face-down exiled card whose resulting spell lacks the permission's quality is not playable (can_play false).
record_fields: gen-3 snapshot card face_state and zone of the candidate's card

what_to_detect: A linked ability referring to cards exiled with its object resolves and returns from exile to the battlefield exactly the cards that object's own exiling ability exiled.
near_miss: The linked ability resolves when its object exiled nothing, and no card moves from exile to the battlefield, while cards exiled by other objects stay in exile.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change from_zone exile to_zone battlefield and its subjects
gen-3 snapshot links of type exiled_with from the acting object
